payload.content: Hello all, Taylor here. Let's coordinate our attendance. I see we all have the scheduled exam from 4 to 5, which is strict, so I plan to attend fully then. I suggest attending Volleyball from 3 to 5 to overlap with Jordan and Riley, then maybe attend Board game night from 5 to 7 to overlap with Riley. Music jamming from 6 to 8 also overlaps with Board game night, so we might want to decide which to prioritize. Thoughts?

I want to add that since attending the exam fully is mandatory and best for reward, I will skip Gym play session to avoid penalty and time conflicts. I can attend Volleyball free play from 3 to 4 to overlap with Jordan and Riley partially, then fully attend the exam from 4 to 5. After that, I am open to attending either Board game night or Music jamming session but not both due to overlap. I prefer Board game night from 5 to 7 for better overlap with Riley.

To summarize my proposal: Attend Volleyball free play from 3 to 4, attend Scheduled exam fully from 4 to 5, and attend Board game night fully from 5 to 7. I will skip Gym play session and Music jamming session due to overlap and prioritizing maximum overlap with others.

After the exam, I will skip Board game night to avoid overlap with Avery and attend Music jamming session fully from 6 to 8 to overlap with Avery, Riley, and Taylor. Looking forward to your thoughts on this plan.

For the second Board game night from 5 to 7 with Taylor only, I suggest skipping it to avoid overlap with the other Board game night. For Music jamming session from 6 to 8, I propose attending from 6 to 8 fully to overlap with others there. This means my schedule would be: Volleyball free play 3-5, Scheduled exam 4-5, Board game night 4-5, Board game night 5-7 (skip), Music jamming 6-8. Thoughts?

To clarify, I realize that attending both Board game nights partially overlapping is suboptimal and causes overlap penalty. I will skip the Board game night from 4 to 7 with Jordan and Avery to avoid overlap penalty and only attend the Board game night from 5 to 7 with Taylor. So my refined plan is: Volleyball free play 3-5, Scheduled exam 4-5, skip Board game night 4-7, attend Board game night 5-7, and Music jamming 6-8. I look forward to hearing if this fits with your plans.

Hello all, Taylor here. Thanks for sharing your plans. I see Riley and Jordan plan to attend Volleyball free play fully or near fully from 3 to 5, and I initially proposed attending Volleyball only from 3 to 4 to avoid overlap penalty with the exam from 4 to 5. However, since Riley and Jordan are attending Volleyball from 3 to 5 fully or almost fully, I could also extend my Volleyball attendance to 3 to 5, even if it overlaps with the exam at 4, but that would cause overlap penalties because the exam is strict and I must attend fully 4 to 5. Therefore, I will stick with Volleyball 3 to 4 to avoid overlap penalties. I also see Riley plans to attend Music jamming fully from 6 to 8, but I prefer to attend Board game night fully from 5 to 7 to overlap with Riley there. If Riley prefers to attend Music jamming fully, I suggest Riley prioritize that and I skip Music jamming. I am ready to finalize my plan: Volleyball free play 3-4, Scheduled exam 4-5 fully, Board game night 5-7 fully, skip Gym play and Music jamming.

To summarize for clarity: I will attend Volleyball free play from 3 to 4, attend Scheduled exam fully from 4 to 5, and attend Board game night fully from 5 to 7. I will skip Gym play session and Music jamming session to maximize reward and avoid overlap penalty.
Looking forward to others confirming their plans or giving feedback.
